title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the total cross section must be correctly stated.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The application of conservation of mechanical energy must be correctly utilized in the derivation.

title: Angular Momentum
description: Important Criteria: The use of angular momentum conservation must be correctly applied to relate impact parameter and closest distance.

title: Impact Parameter
description: Important Criteria: The expression for the impact parameter b must be derived correctly.

title: Condition for Striking
description: Essential Criteria: The condition r < R for the comet to strike the sun must be clearly stated.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes in the energy or angular momentum equations will lead to incorrect results.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Failing to include the factor of pi in the final cross section expression will result in a significant error.
